blocks.rationale: Create a compact terminal helper around one coupled current-source assessment. Earlier airline drafts repeatedly failed because related fee components were requested separately or left unresolved; this reader asks for the complete bag-fee subtotal while preserving the ticket price as a distinct fact.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: baggage_fee_subtotal
inputs.question: What is the complete integer baggage-fee subtotal for all current items, excluding the ticket price, after applying the personal-item and carry-on limits, checked-bag ordinal fees, cabin and route benefits, weight allowances, overweight bands, summed-dimension oversize bands, and the higher-only rule for simultaneous overweight and oversize charges?

skill.intent: Return the exact integer ticket price plus the complete baggage-fee subtotal for the current itinerary.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all applicable fees for every current bag.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What ticket price is stated in the current facts?

fields.name: baggage_fee_subtotal
fields.question: What total baggage fees apply to all current items before adding the ticket price?

reads.question: Assess the current passenger's ordered items and applicable baggage rules as one coupled record, returning the stated ticket price and the complete fee subtotal excluding that ticket price.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply at most one qualifying personal-item allowance and one qualifying carry-on allowance before assigning successive checked-bag positions.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the current route, cabin, complimentary-bag benefits, ordinal checked fees, weight allowances, and summed-dimension oversize bands to every checked item.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For a checked bag that is both overweight and oversize, include only the higher excess fee in addition to its checked-bag fee.

source_provenance.quote: The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

blocks.rationale: Preserve item-level auditability while avoiding the missing parallel-array failures seen in earlier drafts. A single joint reader returns one final fee per current item, and the helper performs only stable integer aggregation.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: per_item_final_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in stated order, what final fee applies after allocating only the dimensional allowances the item qualifies for, assigning remaining items successive checked positions, applying the exact route-and-cabin base schedule and complimentary benefits, applying the applicable checked-bag weight allowance and excess bands, summing outside dimensions for oversize bands, and using only the higher simultaneous overweight or oversize fee? Return zero for an item carried without charge.

skill.intent: Return the exact integer ticket price plus one jointly assessed final fee for each current item.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all final per-item baggage fees.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What is the stated ticket price?

fields.name: per_item_final_fees
fields.question: What complete fee applies to each current item in order, using zero for an item carried without charge?

reads.question: Jointly classify and price every current item under all applicable carried-item, checked-position, route, cabin, weight, and size rules while preserving the stated item order.

origin.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).

source_obligations.statement: Use the personal-item allowance only for an item within its stated dimensions and the carry-on allowance only for an item within the carry-on dimensions, with no more than one of each.

origin.quote: All bag fees are non-refundable and apply per person, each way, even if you buy or get an upgrade that includes free checked bags.

source_obligations.statement: Assign checked-bag ordinals only after carried items are allocated, then apply the current route, cabin, and complimentary-bag rules to those positions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each checked item, add its base fee and the higher of its applicable overweight and oversize fees.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

blocks.rationale: Offer a middle-granularity alternative that remembers the two legal stages most often confused in prior reads: positional base fees and excess-condition fees. Both totals are acquired by one coupled reader, then combined deterministically with the ticket price.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: checked_base_fee_total
inputs.question: What is the aggregate base checked-bag fee for all current items after applying qualifying carried-item allowances, checked ordinals, the current route and cabin, and all applicable complimentary-bag benefits, but before overweight or oversize charges?

inputs.name: excess_fee_total
inputs.question: What is the aggregate excess-condition fee for all current checked items after applying the correct weight allowance and overweight band to each checked position, summing each item's outside dimensions for its oversize band, and selecting only the higher overweight or oversize fee for each item?

skill.intent: Calculate the exact integer total from the ticket price, aggregate checked-bag base fees, and aggregate higher-only excess fees.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus aggregate base and excess baggage fees.
outputs.name: answer

source_obligations.statement: After allocating qualifying carried items, total the base fees for successive checked positions under the current route, cabin, and complimentary-bag rules.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each checked item, determine its overweight and oversize charges and include only the higher one in the aggregate excess-fee total.
